description.value:
Until you dismiss it with an action or the power ends, you use the Force to alter your apparent appearance, including height by about a foot in either direction, build, and overall look, though not your basic body structure, extending the illusion to your clothing, weapons, and other worn or carried items.

The disguise is purely visual; physical contact reveals your true size and shape. A creature that spends its action examining you can see through the illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your force save DC.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
